name: Rose Keep — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Rose-pink keep on an irregular rock ledge, cylindrical turrets with burgundy conical roofs, arched windows/portal, stepped exterior terraces and dense rose climbers. Miniature plan has projecting round tower seats; isometric extends castle along raised rock shoulders. Hidden layout inference: A short winding stair climbs to a sheltered entry terrace, then a compact courtyard between attached towers. Outer rose walk follows cliff return and reconnects at gate; keep tower windows clear and use restrained gold rose-banner accents. Hidden rear court is an inference. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B04-STRUCT-001 — Rose Keep — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need irregular stone/fort-wall returns, cylindrical tower-wall window bands, cone roof seats, stair-to-terrace corners and climbing-rose attachment layout. Source roofs, rose relief, pink masonry and banners already supply detail vocabulary. Pollinators/robins inhabit planted ledges. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
